evidence.detail: OG tags only render when og_title is present; most views do not set this
deck and archetype views implement og_title/og_url/og_description; card view does not
Card view has no og_title, og_url, or og_description methods; card pages produce no OG metadata
bakert comment on #1551 explicitly flags 'need to decide about slugs' (issue #1566) as a blocker for the canonical URL part

triage.notes: Partially addressed for deck and archetype pages. Blocked on #1566 for canonical URL. Adding og_title/og_url/og_description to card.py and other high-traffic views would be straightforward but the canonical URL question must be settled first.
